purpose: Attribute the B05 failure of the G4→G6 Layer-ROM event repair to representation/placement versus reduced propagation/closure.

authority.reference_harness: P2A B05 GW_LB R256_T8 materialized from frozen ROM-PURPOSE harness

prospective_decisions.CLOSURE_PROPAGATION_DEFECT_SUPPORTED: At G4 or G6, same-partition Richards is componentwise better than Layer-ROM on the event vector, with at least one strict improvement.
prospective_decisions.REPRESENTATION_PLACEMENT_DEFECT_SUPPORTE: Same-partition Richards retains the Layer-ROM event defect at both G4 and G6 with no material event improvement.
prospective_decisions.MIXED_ATTRIBUTION: Same-partition Richards improves some event components but does not remove the persistent reversal-sequence/timing failure, or attribution differs between G4 and G6.
prospective_decisions.G6_SPATIAL_INFORMATION_VALUE: COR_G6 is componentwise no worse than COR_G4 on the event vector and strictly better on at least one event component.
prospective_decisions.NO_G6_SPATIAL_INFORMATION_VALUE: COR_G6 does not improve the event vector over COR_G4.

stop_rules: Do not execute G8 in this work unit.
